title: Brita is better
text: Brita is better. I think Brita is better than this. This water filter dispenser is overpriced and perhaps it’s made in Germany. I don’t think it works as good as Brita.

product_metadata.title: HUBER Extra Large 40 Cup Water Filter Pitcher Dispenser for Fridge and Countertop, 2.5 Gallons with Filter, Water Purifier, Filtered Water Dispenser
features: Why is HUBER Water Filter Dispenser considered outstanding by its users? – Simply put, our highly advanced filtering system ensures maximal purification for the best-tasting water. Unique, patented Huber technology not only reduces heavy metals such as lead, mercury, and copper, chlorine taste, impurities and scale-forming substances, but also lets those valuable minerals through. The result is fresh, natural, balanced water - ranking highest in consumer taste tests throughout Europe.

German Technology & Design – The versatile unit is designed as a water dispenser for fridge or as a countertop water filter, positioned in a cool area, ready for drinking. Huber's strict quality control standards and rigorous testing ensure the highest quality, so you can enjoy healthy water at home, in the office, or on the go. Unit measures L12.2ʺ x W8.3ʺ x H8.7ʺ.

Eco Friendly – Save up to 300 single-use plastic bottles per filter or up to 2000 bottles a year while enjoying the purest tasting water! In addition, our fridge water dispenser enhances the aroma and taste of tea and coffee and provides a more refined "crema" for your coffee.

Unsurpassed Filtration – Enjoy filtered water faster with no pre-soaking required to activate the filter. Our replaceable water  filter delivers stable performance during use, effectively reducing sediment, improving taste and odor without properties getting packed down and becoming inefficient. Our handy indicator will keep you up to date with when your filter needs replacing too.

Satisfaction guaranteed with HUBER – We deeply care for our customers and want only the best for you. Fast and professional customer service is always here to help you with anything you need! We promise to bring you nothing but the best quality water dispenser on the market!
